issues.title: Minimum thickness 0.5 mm
issues.message: Thinnest wall is 0.35 mm (limit 0.50 mm), across about 3.0 mm² of the part. Walls this thin may print with gaps or not at all.
issues.suggestion: Thicken thin walls, fins and plates to at least 0.5 mm — 1.2 mm or more for strength.

issues.title: No thin vertical stalks
issues.message: A column about 1.3 mm wide and 11.0 mm tall (8.4× taller than wide) may wobble while printing and snap off during handling.
issues.suggestion: Thicken the column to at least 2 mm, add a fillet or brace at its base, or print it lying down.

issues.title: Requires Support
issues.message: About 263 mm² of overhangs (35° or less from horizontal) will need support. Highlighted areas show where.
issues.suggestion: Rotate the part so fewer surfaces face downward, or add chamfers under overhangs.

issues.title: 1 mm bottom chamfer
issues.message: Recommend adding 1mm chamfer to the base of all parts for maximum reliability and highest tolerance.

issues.title: No thin vertical stalks
issues.message: A column about 3.1 mm wide and 17.0 mm tall (5.4× taller than wide) may wobble while printing and snap off during handling.
issues.suggestion: Thicken the column to at least 2 mm, add a fillet or brace at its base, or print it lying down.

issues.title: No large spidery pieces
issues.message: This large part is thin on average (about 1.99 mm). It may flex or warp.
issues.suggestion: Add ribs or thicken the thinnest sections.

issues.title: Potential Excessive Support
issues.message: Estimated support is about 196% of the part's volume (19.4 cm³ of support for 9.9 cm³ of part). Highlighted areas overhang 35° or less from horizontal.
issues.suggestion: Rotate the part to reduce overhangs, add chamfers under overhangs, or split it into pieces that print flat.

issues.title: Requires Support
issues.message: About 1687 mm² of overhangs (35° or less from horizontal) will need support. Highlighted areas show where.
issues.suggestion: Rotate the part so fewer surfaces face downward, or add chamfers under overhangs.
